headerDisplay: Bond Bridge over the local network. Find the token in the Bond Home app: tap the bridge, then Settings, then look under the Bond's details.

host.title: IP address
host.description: The plugin follows the bridge if this address changes later.

hideDeviceIds.title: Device ids to hide
hideDeviceIds.description: Ids are shown in the startup report in the log.

correctStateSwitch.title: Add a Correct State switch to each device
correctStateSwitch.description: While the switch is on (30 seconds), changes in Apple Home fix what the tile shows and send nothing to the device.

dimmerSwitch.title: Add a Dimmer switch for lights that only dim by holding the button

breezeSwitch.title: Add a Breeze switch to fans that have a breeze (natural wind) mode

timerSwitches.title: Add sleep timer switches (Off in 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h) to fans that have a timer
